threat_event: A technician views, copies, or shares personal content (photos, messages, saved passwords) from a customer device in the shop's custody
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No rule on what may be opened; shared local bench account; USB storage allowed; no bench logging; no confidentiality agreement; 2026-03-14 complaint inconclusive for lack of records
affected_asset_or_process: Customer devices in custody; SYS-05; SYS-06; BP-02; BP-04
existing_controls: Cameras at the bench; signed intake consent to power on and test
treatment_plan: Customer device access standard (POL-04 4.4) with a test checklist; named bench accounts; USB storage blocked except on the transfer station; signed confidentiality agreements; device-in-custody log

threat_event: The shared Counter login is phished or reused and ticket notes holding passcodes, account passwords, and card numbers are exported
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared login without MFA on both counter PCs; about 5,200 tickets with passcodes and 310 with account passwords in a note field visible to all users; no export alerts
existing_controls: Vendor lockout after failed sign-ins; MFA on named accounts
treatment_plan: Named counter accounts with MFA; stop collecting account passwords; restricted passcode field cleared at release; purge historical notes; SYS-01 export alerts to the Shop Manager

threat_event: A former workforce member signs in with the unchanged shared Counter password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Password unchanged since 2024; a Counter Associate who knew it left on 2026-05-08; no leaver checklist
treatment_plan: Change the Counter password at once; replace with named accounts (R-002); same-day leaver checklist; monthly account reconciliation

threat_event: Customer data kept on the bench storage and in the backup long after the job ends is exposed in a theft, intrusion, or ransomware attack, widening the breach
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 2.3 TB from about 610 jobs older than 30 days on the bench storage; 1-year backup retention; no retention rule
treatment_plan: 30-day retention after the customer collects the device; purge the backlog; encrypt the bench storage; cut backup retention for bench data to 30 days

threat_event: Recycled customer devices or retired shop PCs leave the shop with readable customer data
threat_source: Technician error; recycler or downstream handler
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Factory reset only; no per-device record or check; no SP 800-88 method; certificates per pickup, not per device
affected_asset_or_process: Recycling drop-off devices; retired SYS-04 and SYS-05 equipment; BP-08
existing_controls: Quarterly pickup with a certificate per pickup
treatment_plan: Sanitization standard from NIST SP 800-88 Rev. 2 (Clear, Purge, or Destroy by media type; cryptographic erase for encrypted phones; verification); record per device; recycler certificate listing serial numbers

threat_event: Malware on a customer device under repair spreads across the staff Wi-Fi to the counter PCs, bench PCs, and bench storage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customer devices join the staff Wi-Fi; flat network; bench antivirus often off
existing_controls: MSP firewall; guest Wi-Fi separated; antivirus on office endpoints
treatment_plan: Separate network for customer devices and bench equipment with no route to the counter PCs; bench PCs under MSP management with EDR

threat_event: Ransomware delivered by a phishing email encrypts the counter PCs and the bench storage and stops intake and repairs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No awareness training; flat network; backup never restore-tested and deletable with one MSP password; no EDR
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04; SYS-06; SYS-08; BP-01 to BP-04
existing_controls: MSP patching and antivirus; firewall; MFA on email
treatment_plan: Training and quarterly phishing simulations; MSP-managed EDR with alert monitoring; immutable backup with MFA on the console; quarterly restore tests

threat_event: Card numbers written on sticky notes or typed into ticket notes during phone payments are exposed, and the shop loses SAQ P2PE eligibility
threat_source: Workforce error; any person with access to notes
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No rule for phone payments; 11 ticket notes with full card numbers found 2026-07-22; sticky notes at the counter
regulatory_driver: N81-R03 (PCI DSS v4.0.1 3.2.1, 3.3.1.2; SAQ P2PE eligibility)
existing_controls: P2PE terminals for all card entry
treatment_plan: Phone payments keyed straight into the terminal while the customer is on the line; purge the 11 notes; block card-number patterns in notes if the vendor allows; staff training

threat_event: A payment terminal is tampered with or swapped and goes unnoticed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No terminal list or serial numbers; no inspections; spare kept in an unlocked drawer
treatment_plan: Terminal list with serial numbers; weekly inspection log; spare locked away; tamper training

threat_event: Backups cannot be restored when needed, or an attacker deletes them with the MSP's password
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Never restore-tested; one MSP admin login without MFA; not immutable
treatment_plan: MFA on the backup console; first restore test by 2026-09-30, then quarterly; immutable retention

threat_event: The intake form's promise that technicians never access personal data, or the website claim of AI diagnosis that is right every time, is treated as a deceptive practice
threat_source: FTC or Florida Department of Legal Affairs; customer complaint
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Statements are not true in practice; no substantiation for the AI claim
treatment_plan: Rewrite the intake notice to describe the access testing needs and make it true through the access standard; remove the AI claim

threat_event: The AI assistant gives one customer another customer's details, quotes wrong prices, gives unsafe repair advice, or sends passcodes (typed in chat or held in ticket notes) to a model provider that may reuse them
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Turned on without review; no data-use terms; no testing; diagnostic suggestions send whole tickets, including passcode notes; vendor terms allow use to improve the service
existing_controls: Status replies only after ticket number and phone number match
treatment_plan: P10 conditions: diagnostic suggestions off until passcode notes are purged; AI disclosure; passcode masking; price answers from the price list only; safety answers handed to staff; data-use terms; monthly review

threat_event: The MSP's remote management tool is compromised and used against every office endpoint
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MSP has admin rights on all office endpoints; no evidence of MFA on its tool; no incident notice term in the contract
treatment_plan: Annual MSP security questionnaire with MFA evidence; 24-hour incident notice and technician list in the contract

threat_event: A ticketing and POS vendor outage stops intake, payment records, and release for a business day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS system of record; vendor RTO target 8 h exceeds the BIA's 4 h; no paper kit
treatment_plan: Paper downtime kit (intake forms, numbered tags, release log); weekly ticket list export to the Shop Manager's laptop (encrypted)

threat_event: The single internet line fails and the terminals, SYS-01, and email are unreachable
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One business internet line; no failover
existing_controls: Phone hotspot on a staff phone
treatment_plan: Cellular failover router

threat_event: A hurricane closes the shop for days; customer devices in custody are damaged, lost, or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No hurricane checklist; about 60 devices in custody at any time; no off-site record of which devices are where
affected_asset_or_process: Customer devices in custody; whole shop
treatment_plan: Hurricane checklist (P05 section 6): stop intake, call customers, bag and log devices, secure them in the locked cabinet or off site with the Owner

threat_event: A customer device is stolen from the shop or released to the wrong person
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Release by name only on busy days; spare devices and finished repairs on open shelves behind the counter
treatment_plan: Release only on claim ticket or photo ID, recorded in SYS-01; finished devices in a locked cabinet

threat_event: The outside data recovery lab, the courier, or the recycler loses or misuses customer data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No contract security or data-use terms; drives shipped with the customer's name on the label
affected_asset_or_process: Customer drives; recycled devices; BP-04; BP-08
treatment_plan: Vendor list; written terms (confidentiality, use only for the job, deletion, 10-day breach notice); ship drives by ticket number only

threat_event: A business email compromise of the Shop Manager's mailbox redirects a parts distributor payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA in place but no training; no call-back rule for bank detail changes
treatment_plan: Call-back rule for any bank detail change (POL-02 C.7); training (R-007)

threat_event: Bench workstations, outside MSP management, are infected by flashing or diagnostic tools from untrusted sources
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bench PCs unpatched; antivirus often off; tools downloaded from forums; one free remote desktop tool installed
treatment_plan: Bring bench PCs under the MSP contract (patching, EDR with tool exclusions approved by the Senior Technician); approved tool list; remove the remote desktop tool; standard image

threat_event: Printed background check reports are seen by the wrong person or thrown away without shredding
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reports in an unlocked desk drawer; no disposal rule
treatment_plan: Reports moved to the locked HR folder and the screening vendor's portal copy kept instead; shred printed copies when no longer needed

threat_event: The Senior Technician or the Shop Manager is unavailable for weeks and data recovery, bench systems, or the security program stop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Only the Senior Technician knows the bench systems and data recovery; only the Shop Manager runs the security tasks
existing_controls: Owner can do every counter and repair job
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low: document bench procedures in the standard image work (R-020); the Owner shadows the monthly security tasks

threat_event: A breach notice deadline is missed because nobody knows the duties or contacts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan; no counsel or insurer contact at hand; staff do not know the processor's notice term
treatment_plan: POL-03 and P08 runbook with a printed binder; tabletop with the MSP

threat_event: An attacker or a customer device on the staff Wi-Fi reaches the bench storage's web console and signs in with the default administrator account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default administrator account; password written on a label on the device; console reachable from the staff Wi-Fi (found by P07 on 2026-08-11)
treatment_plan: Disable the default account; named administrator account with a strong password; remove the label; restrict the console to the bench network
